items.source: JobDetail(Impl) itself is already a JavaBean but lacks sensible defaults. This class uses the Spring bean name as job name, and the Quartz default group ("DEFAULT") as job group if not specified.
items.translation: `JobDetail(Impl)` 本身已是一个 JavaBean，但缺乏合理的默认值。如果未指定，该类将使用 Spring Bean 名称作为作业名称，并使用 Quartz 的默认组（"DEFAULT"）作为作业组。

items.source: Note: When using persistent job stores where JobDetail contents will be kept in the database, do not put an ApplicationContext reference into the JobDataMap but rather into the SchedulerContext.
items.translation: 注意：在使用持久化作业存储（JobDetail 内容将保存在数据库中）时，不要将 ApplicationContext 引用放入 JobDataMap，而应放入 SchedulerContext。

items.source:
These objects will be available to this Job only,
in contrast to objects in the SchedulerContext.
items.translation: 这些对象仅对本作业可用，与调度器上下文中的对象不同。

items.source:
Note: When using persistent Jobs whose JobDetail will be kept in the
database, do not put Spring-managed beans or an ApplicationContext
reference into the JobDataMap but rather into the SchedulerContext.
items.translation: 注意：在使用持久化作业（其 JobDetail 将保存在数据库中）时，请勿将 Spring 管理的 Bean 或 ApplicationContext 引用放入 JobDataMap 中，而应将其放入 SchedulerContext 中。

items.source:
In case of a QuartzJobBean, the reference will be applied to the Job
instance as bean property. An "applicationContext" attribute will correspond
to a "setApplicationContext" method in that scenario.
items.translation: 对于 QuartzJobBean，引用将作为 Bean 属性应用于 Job 实例。在这种情况下，"applicationContext" 属性将对应于 "setApplicationContext" 方法。

items.source:
Note that BeanFactory callback interfaces like ApplicationContextAware
are not automatically applied to Quartz Job instances, because Quartz
itself is responsible for the lifecycle of its Jobs.
items.translation: 请注意，像 `ApplicationContextAware` 这样的 BeanFactory 回调接口不会自动应用到 Quartz Job 实例上，因为 Quartz 本身负责其 Job 的生命周期。

items.source: Return the job's JobDataMap.
items.translation: 返回作业的 JobDataMap。

items.source: Set a textual description for this job.
items.translation: 为此任务设置文本描述。

items.source: Specify the job's group.
items.translation: 指定作业的组。

items.source: Specify the job's implementation class.
items.translation: 指定作业的实现类。

items.source: Set the job's JobDataMap.
items.translation: 设置作业的 JobDataMap。

items.source: Specify the job's name.
items.translation: 指定作业的名称。

items.source:
Specify the job's durability, i.e. whether it should remain stored
in the job store even if no triggers point to it anymore.
items.translation: 指定作业的持久性，即即使不再有任何触发器指向它，是否仍将其保留在作业存储中。

items.source:
Set the recovery flag for this job, i.e. whether the job should
get re-executed if a 'recovery' or 'fail-over' situation is encountered.
items.translation: 为此作业设置恢复标志，即当遇到“恢复”或“故障转移”情况时，该作业是否应重新执行。

items.source: NOTE: This method returning false does not necessarily indicate that returned objects are independent instances. An implementation of the extended SmartFactoryBean interface may explicitly indicate independent instances through its SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype() method. Plain FactoryBean implementations which do not implement this extended interface are simply assumed to always return independent instances if the isSingleton() implementation returns false.
items.translation: 注意： 此方法返回 false 并不一定表示返回的对象是独立实例。实现扩展的SmartFactoryBean接口可以通过其SmartFactoryBean.isPrototype()方法明确指示独立实例。未实现此扩展接口的普通FactoryBean实现，如果isSingleton()实现返回 false，则假定其始终返回独立实例。

items.source: Invoked after population of normal bean properties but before an init callback such as InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() or a custom init-method. Invoked after ResourceLoaderAware.setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader), ApplicationEventPublisherAware.setApplicationEventPublisher(ApplicationEventPublisher) and MessageSourceAware, if applicable.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。在 ResourceLoaderAware.setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader)、ApplicationEventPublisherAware.setApplicationEventPublisher(ApplicationEventPublisher) 和 MessageSourceAware（如果适用）之后调用。

items.source: FactoryBeans are allowed to return null objects. The bean factory will consider this as a normal value to be used and will not throw a FactoryBeanNotInitializedException in this case. However, FactoryBean implementations are encouraged to throw FactoryBeanNotInitializedException themselves, as appropriate.
items.translation: FactoryBeans 允许返回 `null` 对象。在此情况下，Bean 工厂会将其视为正常值并使用该值，而不会抛出 `FactoryBeanNotInitializedException`。不过，建议 FactoryBean 实现类根据具体情况自行抛出 `FactoryBeanNotInitializedException`。

items.source: NOTE: If a FactoryBean indicates that it holds a singleton object, the object returned from getObject() might get cached by the owning BeanFactory. Hence, do not return true unless the FactoryBean always exposes the same reference.
items.translation: 注意：如果 FactoryBean 表明它持有一个单例对象，那么从 getObject() 返回的对象可能会被其拥有的 BeanFactory 缓存。因此，除非 FactoryBean 始终暴露相同的引用，否则不要返回 true。

items.source: Invoked after population of normal bean properties but before an init callback such as InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() or a custom init-method.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但在初始化回调（如InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。

items.source: As with a BeanFactory, this allows support for both the Singleton and Prototype design patterns.
items.translation: 与BeanFactory一样，这支持单例和原型两种设计模式。

items.source: If this FactoryBean is not fully initialized yet at the time of the call (for example because it is involved in a circular reference), throw a corresponding FactoryBeanNotInitializedException.
items.translation: 如果在此调用时该 FactoryBean 尚未完全初始化（例如因为它涉及循环引用），则抛出相应的 FactoryBeanNotInitializedException。

items.source: NOTE: Autowiring will simply ignore FactoryBeans that return null here. Therefore, it is highly recommended to implement this method properly, using the current state of the FactoryBean.
items.translation: 注意： 自动装配将简单地忽略在此处返回`null`的 FactoryBean。因此，强烈建议使用 FactoryBean 的当前状态正确实现此方法。

items.source: The default implementation returns true, since a FactoryBean typically manages a singleton instance.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 true，因为 FactoryBean 通常管理一个单例实例。

items.source: This method can be called before this FactoryBean has been fully initialized. It must not rely on state created during initialization; of course, it can still use such state if available.
items.translation: 此方法可以在该 FactoryBean 完全初始化之前被调用。它不能依赖在初始化期间创建的状态；当然，如果可用，它仍然可以使用此类状态。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source:
This allows one to check for specific types of beans without
instantiating objects, for example on autowiring.
items.translation: 这允许在例如自动装配时，无需实例化对象即可检查特定类型的 Bean。

items.source:
In the case of implementations that create a singleton object,
this method should try to avoid singleton creation as far as possible;
it should rather estimate the type in advance.
For prototypes, returning a meaningful type here is advisable too.
items.translation: 对于创建单例对象的实现，此方法应尽可能避免创建单例；相反，它应预先估算类型。对于原型对象，在此处返回有意义的类型也是可取的。

items.source:
The singleton status of the FactoryBean itself will generally
be provided by the owning BeanFactory; usually, it has to be
defined as singleton there.
items.translation: FactoryBean 本身的单例状态通常由拥有它的 BeanFactory 提供；通常，它必须在那里被定义为单例。

Note that this name is the actual bean name used in the factory, which may differ from the originally specified name: in particular for inner bean names, the actual bean name might have been made unique through appending "#..." suffixes. Use the BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String) method to extract the original bean name (without suffix), if desired.
